title: Jude Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on Jude 1: contending for the faith, the warnings from Egypt, Sodom and the angels, Michael and the devil, and the words of Enoch.

questions.text: How does Jude describe himself in the first verse?
questions.explanation: Jude 1:1 calls him Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and brother of James.

answers.text: A servant of Jesus Christ and brother of James
An apostle sent out to the Gentiles
The elder of the assembly in Asia
A prophet of the last time

questions.text: What does Jude exhort them to do in his letter?
questions.explanation: Jude 1:3 says he was constrained to write exhorting them to contend earnestly for the faith which was once for all delivered to the saints.

answers.text: Leave their cities and flee to the hills
Contend earnestly for the faith delivered to the saints
Appoint new elders in every assembly
Keep silent before the ungodly men

questions.text: What did the Lord do after saving a people out of the land of Egypt?
questions.explanation: Jude 1:5 says that the Lord, having saved a people out of Egypt, afterward destroyed those who did not believe.

answers.text: He gave them another land
He sent them more prophets
He destroyed those who did not believe
He forgave them everything

questions.text: What happened to the angels who did not keep their first domain?
questions.explanation: Jude 1:6 says he has kept them in everlasting bonds under darkness for the judgment of the great day.

answers.text: They were sent out to the nations
They were given new dwelling places
They were made faithful witnesses
They are kept in everlasting bonds under darkness

questions.text: Who contended with the devil and argued about the body of Moses?
questions.explanation: Jude 1:9 says that Michael, the archangel, contended with the devil and argued about the body of Moses.

answers.text: Michael, the archangel
Enoch, the seventh from Adam
Cain, who was of the evil one
Korah, who rebelled

questions.text: What did Michael say instead of bringing an abusive condemnation against the devil?
questions.explanation: Jude 1:9 says Michael dared not bring an abusive condemnation, but said, "May the Lord rebuke you!"

answers.text: "Depart from me!"
"Woe to you!"
"May the Lord rebuke you!"
"The Lord is my judge!"

questions.text: Whose rebellion does the letter say these men perished in?
questions.explanation: Jude 1:11 says they went in the way of Cain, ran riotously in the error of Balaam for hire, and perished in Korah's rebellion.

answers.text: Balak's
Korah's
Pharaoh's
Enoch's

questions.text: Which images does the letter use for these men who feast with them?
questions.explanation: Jude 1:12 calls them clouds without water, carried along by winds, and autumn trees without fruit, twice dead.

answers.text: Green olive trees and springs of water
Bright lamps burning in a dark house
Sheep without a shepherd to lead them
Clouds without water and autumn trees without fruit

questions.text: Who prophesied that the Lord came with ten thousands of his holy ones?
questions.explanation: Jude 1:14 says that Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied this about them.

answers.text: Enoch, the seventh from Adam
Moses, whose body was argued over
James, the brother of Jude
Michael, the archangel

questions.text: What did the apostles say there would be in the last time?
questions.explanation: Jude 1:18 says they told them there will be mockers in the last time, walking after their own ungodly lusts.

answers.text: Famines and troubles in many places
Peace among all the nations of earth
Signs and wonders in the sky
Mockers, walking after their own ungodly lusts
